claim_boundary: This boundary records a ROADMAP-level AlphaEvolve source-span coverage matrix for all 55 PDF-verified named main-text sections, figures, tables, Appendix A/B spans, and named application sections, plus 846 bounded claim-level records across Table 1, Section 2, the Abstract, Introduction, Discussion, collaborator context, Section 3.1, Table 2, Figure 4, footnote 3, Section 3.2, Figure 5, the Section 3.3 opening, Section 3.3.1, Figure 6, Section 3.3.2, Figure 7, Section 3.3.3, Section 3.3.4, Section 4, Figure 8, and Section 5 Related Work, Appendix A, Table 3, and Figure 9. The Section 5 inventory separates 59 source-context-only literature claims from 26 implementation-relevant claims. The Appendix A inventory records 29 prose/caption claims, all 54 Table 3 rows, and 48 Figure 9 claims. The Appendix B inventory records 188 claims across all 13 subsections and Figures 10-14. It also records lexical source and bibliography linkage for all 195 TeX citation uses, 240 key links, and 120 compiled references without classifying supported propositions, source sufficiency, or implementation relevance. It also records construct-level dispositions for all 30 retained-source captions, displayed equations, and semantic footnotes, plus row- and cell-level dispositions for all 83 rows and 240 cells in Tables 1-3, plus environment- and line-level dispositions for all 8 retained TeX code listing environments and all 305 physical source lines, plus delimiter-level dispositions for all 309 explicit TeX math constructs, split into 291 inline and 18 display constructs, without claiming mathematical correctness or result reproduction, plus paragraph- and sentence-level dispositions for all 128 retained TeX prose paragraphs and all 402 grammatical sentences, with 372 mapped to existing bounded claims, 30 reviewed as nonclaims, and zero unmapped or unresolved sentences, plus 812 atomic propositions across all 244 sentences from the Abstract through Section 4 ablations, with 753 mapped to bounded claims and 59 dispositioned as context, outlook, or interpretation. It does not claim proposition coverage for the remaining 158 prose sentences or independent semantic exhaustiveness, image-pixel coverage, citation-level proposition exhaustiveness, or independent semantic review. It also records paper-status rows, and TODO/non-goal/phase proof. It does not claim whole-paper claim-level requirement exhaustiveness, a complete application-result claim matrix, status-row to ROADMAP disposition map, missing/partial TODO proof, non-goal decision map, phase-priority map, CI source-span exhaustiveness gate, or owner review signoff.
